{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [
      "human_approval_required_before_numerical_workflow",
      "no_numerical_outputs_generated_by_llm"
    ]
  },
  "decision": "accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "The request is for an upward reserve sizing study in MISO with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 10.0. The study schema is prepared for human approval before any numerical computation. Numerical outputs such as reserve values, mean costs, coverage values, confidence intervals, bootstrap claims, and dispatch results are produced only by the verified numerical workflow, not by the LLM.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "Region MISO, horizon 120 minutes, and shortfall cost 10.0 are supported. The request explicitly requires approval before computation, and no numerical outputs are requested or generated here.",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "MISO",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "prepare_study_schema_with_rolling_window_configuration",
    "require_human_approval_before_numerical_workflow",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_after_approval",
    "report_only_verified_numerical_outputs"
  ]
}
